  was a misconfigured kubelet setting where imageGCHighThresholdPercent was
  raised to 95%, preventing automatic garbage collection. The fix involved
  resetting the threshold to 80 in the node-config DaemonSet, pruning unused
  images via crictl, and restarting the kubelet service.
---

## Summary

Resolved persistent pod evictions on worker-node-7 caused by DiskPressure due to /var/lib/containerd reaching 94% capacity. The root cause was a misconfigured kubelet setting where imageGCHighThresholdPercent was raised to 95%, preventing automatic garbage collection. The fix involved resetting the threshold to 80 in the node-config DaemonSet, pruning unused images via crictl, and restarting the kubelet service.

## Key topics

- Kubernetes DiskPressure
- kubelet imageGCHighThresholdPercent
- containerd garbage collection
- pod eviction troubleshooting
- DaemonSet configuration management
